description: Verify all required Terraform variables are filled

questions.question: Are all required environment variables (REQUIRED) filled?
Are database credentials and secrets externalized?
questions.notes: Use var.* references, never hardcode in .tf files

questions.question: Are all variable descriptions clear?
questions.notes: Future users should understand each variable's purpose

questions.question: Are default values appropriate for dev environment?
questions.notes: Defaults should be dev-safe (small instances, no backup)

questions.question: Are environment-specific overrides documented?
questions.notes: How to override for staging/prod (instance sizes, replica counts)

questions.question: Are sensitive variable types marked?
questions.notes: Passwords, tokens, keys should have sensitive = true
